_comment: Fixed task splits of `aidev-evolve eval`: Terminal-Bench 2.1 at task_commit, GLM-5.3-Flash at low effort. validation: the 8 tasks every version is scored on (their trajectories are read while fixing). heldout: 21 tasks nobody reads, for the check at the end. Chosen on 19 Nov 2026 from paired sweeps on a 34-task pool, 4 trials each, so that each of the three planted flaws costs passes on the validation tasks; the other 5 pool tasks are not used. eval_budget_s: agent time per task (chosen on 25 Nov 2026 from ladders at 90, 120 and 180 s).
